evidence: https://wwwcdn.imo.org/localresources/en/KnowledgeCentre/IndexofIMOResolutions/MSCResolutions/MSC.355(92).pdf — Resolution MSC.355(92) (Adopted on 21 June 2013) 'the said amendments shall enter into force on 1 July 2014'; 'ANNEX III CONTROL AND VERIFICATION 25 The existing section 4 is replaced with the following: 4 Structurally sensitive components ... (ii) Serious deficiency requiring immediate out-of-service determination / (iii) Deficiency requiring advice to owner and restrictions for transport'. Top rail (ii) 'in excess of 60 mm ... 45 mm', (iii) 'in excess of 40 mm ... 10 mm'; Header (ii) 80/80, (iii) 50/10; Sill (ii) 100/100, (iii) 60/10; Corner posts (ii) 50/50, (iii) 30mm or cracks of any length; Corner fittings (ii) 'Missing corner fittings, any through cracks or tears in the fitting, any deformation of the fitting that precludes full engagement ... or any weld separation of adjoining components in excess of 50 mm'. Understructure (ii)(스페인어판 MSC 92/26/Add.1, directemar.cl 게시): 이웃 크로스 멤버 2개 이상 없음·분리, 또는 전체의 20% 이상 없음·분리. 레일·헤더·실·포스트의 정지 값은 Circ.134와 같고, 피팅·하부 구조는 넓어졌으며, 낮은 단계 기준이 새로 생김.
